The thin-body doctrine, reference-anchor resolution, and ordered-list integrity are file-shape properties of the skills tree, with no home in the CLI, guards, state, or worktree suites — all of which cover module behavior. This suite is also spec #78 P2's byte-budget fence, which has to be a permanent CI-registered check or the ratchet is only a promise.
